units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御（朱雀帝之母）及其父右大臣一派，欲推翻源氏一派，立此八皇子为太子。

en.t: The Kokiden Consort, mother of Emperor Suzaku, and the faction of her father, the Minister of the Right, sought to overthrow Genji's faction and install this Eighth Prince as crown prince.

units.source_text: 后来终于失败，冷泉帝即位，政权全归源氏一派。

en.t: In the end they failed; Emperor Reizei ascended the throne, and all political power passed to Genji's faction.
As a result, the Eighth Prince fell into difficult circumstances.
